evidence.reason: The fixture sets a temporary repository-local user identity but never disables inherited commit.gpgSign. If the developer/global git config enables signing and has no matching key for fixture@example.invalid, the commit at line 94 fails during setUp, erroring every DeployFixture-derived DeployTests case. Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a minimal test-isolation fix and does not change developer configuration.
